New York Cycle Club Weekend Rides

New York, NY · Road

New York Cycle Club Weekend Rides is a road group ride in New York, NY. Schedule: Every Saturday and Sunday, plus select weekdays; start times vary by ride. About 35–100+ depending on level miles, a 19–22 mph / B 15–18 mph / C 12–14 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 19–22 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @newyorkcycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the New York Cycle Club Weekend Rides group ride

The city's largest recreational club runs member-led rides every weekend to Westchester, Connecticut, Long Island and across the Hudson. Three levels. C rides and most B rides are no-drop; A rides are not. Helmets required, no exceptions.
